name: xberg
description: Document-intelligence and developer plugins from xberg-io, each served from its product repository's plugin/ directory at a pinned release tag.

plugins.name: xberg
plugins.description: Local document extraction: text, tables, metadata, images from 107 formats with optional OCR.

plugins.name: crawlberg
plugins.description: Web crawling and scraping with HTML→Markdown and headless-Chrome fallback.

plugins.name: html-to-markdown
plugins.description: Fast, lossless HTML→Markdown conversion with structured metadata, tables, and document-structure extraction.

plugins.name: liter-llm
plugins.description: Universal LLM API client for 174 providers: chat, streaming, tools, embeddings, search, OCR, plus an OpenAI-compatible proxy and an MCP server.

plugins.name: tree-sitter-language-pack
plugins.description: Parse and extract code intelligence from 371 programming languages with tree-sitter: structure, imports, symbols, and syntax-aware chunking.

plugins.name: poly
plugins.description: polylint: one linter and formatter for every language in the repository, driven by poly.toml, with an MCP server exposing check, fix, info and manage tools.

plugins.name: sceptre
plugins.description: Local OCR with CRAFT detection and multilingual CRNN recognition.
